locator.name: the tray store > keeps no bytes of an image refused by the count or the message bound, and keeps a live pick’s bytes

proves.facet: Count/message refusal stores no image bytes, while a still-live pick preserves its shared image bytes.

locator.name: the tray store > sets the default target once, by the first pick (rule 7)

proves.facet: Chat passage defaults to its source; an object defaults to shown chat, later picks leave it unchanged, no shown chat gives no default, and explicit prior choice wins.

locator.name: the tray store > lets a first pick on the review page with its column closed wait for the chat the column shows

proves.facet: A deferred first pick adopts the next shown-chat publication once; explicit choice or leaving the wait blocks later publications from changing targets.

locator.name: the tray store > keeps whole files of distinct comparisons apart across a reload; the same whole file adds nothing

proves.facet: Distinct whole-file comparison identities survive a stored reload, while re-adding the same object adds no second pick.

locator.name: the tray store > decides the default again when the last pick is removed, and keeps a target he chose

proves.facet: Last-pick removal resets an automatic default and pending wait; removing only one of two picks or removing the last with an explicit target preserves the required choice.

locator.name: the tray store > keeps the tray in memory and says so when the browser storage refuses

proves.facet: Quota refusal keeps a reference pick with a named memory-only warning; IndexedDB refusal keeps an image pick and removing it clears that warning.

locator.name: the tray store > survives a reload: a new store reads the same tray from this origin’s storage

proves.facet: A new store using the same storage/image store restores three pick kinds, note, free text and target; the image digest remains present.
